# dagger v0.21.7 - Table of Contents

## Modules

- [Dagger](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.md): The [Dagger](https://dagger.io/) SDK for Elixir.
- [Dagger.Address](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.Address.md): A standardized address to load containers, directories, secrets, and other object types. Address format depends on the type, and is validated at type selection.

- [Dagger.AddressID](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.AddressID.md): A unique identifier for an object.

- [Dagger.Binding](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.Binding.md): Dagger.Binding

- [Dagger.BindingID](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.BindingID.md): A unique identifier for an object.

- [Dagger.BuildArg](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.BuildArg.md): Key value object that represents a build argument.

- [Dagger.CacheSharingMode](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.CacheSharingMode.md): Sharing mode of the cache volume.

- [Dagger.CacheVolume](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.CacheVolume.md): A directory whose contents persist across runs.

- [Dagger.CacheVolumeID](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.CacheVolumeID.md): A unique identifier for an object.

- [Dagger.Changeset](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.Changeset.md): A comparison between two directories representing changes that can be applied.

- [Dagger.ChangesetID](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.ChangesetID.md): A unique identifier for an object.

- [Dagger.ChangesetMergeConflict](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.ChangesetMergeConflict.md): Strategy to use when merging changesets with conflicting changes.

- [Dagger.ChangesetsMergeConflict](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.ChangesetsMergeConflict.md): Strategy to use when merging multiple changesets with git octopus merge.

- [Dagger.Check](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.Check.md): Dagger.Check

- [Dagger.ClientFilesyncMirrorID](https://dagger.hexdocs.pm/Dagger.ClientFilesyncMirrorID.md): A unique identifier for an object.

in the core API. It is not used by user modules and shouldn't ever be as user
module accept input objects via their id rather than graphql input types.
